youtube.text:
Gaylord Palms ice! near Orlando: The Polar Express carved in ice at 9°F, free parkas

When: November 13, 2026 to January 3, 2027, indoors at the Gaylord Palms resort in Kissimmee, Orlando area.

Cost: Parking $38 a day, $55 valet, plus tax. Tickets: regular price not published; check your date and any child prices on GaylordPalmsTickets.com.

Booking: Tickets must be bought in advance at GaylordPalmsTickets.com, for a set date and entry time; entry is not guaranteed if you arrive more than five minutes late. Hours vary by day. You do not need to stay at the hotel.

Family note: Everyone gets a free hooded, calf-length parka; inside it is 9°F. Extras cost more: Snow Flow Mountain (42-inch height minimum), Santa photos, gingerbread decorating and the holiday show are separate tickets.

Checked on the official page October 31: Christmas at Gaylord Palms official site (home page and FAQ).
